meta.title: Jarvis Email Inbox — Request Sequence
meta.subtitle: Approved email to a threaded answer · existing workflow scheduler, registry and orchestrator

messages.label: Poll inbox
messages.note: jarvis_email_inbox; default schedule every 30 minutes after setup

messages.label: Load policy
messages.note: Channel enabled; Workspace enabled; required Gmail tools available

messages.label: Find mail
messages.note: Recent head + independent backlog and arrivals windows; up to 25 IDs per page

messages.label: Admit request
messages.note: Approved From + Gmail authentication; remove quoted text

messages.label: Save pending
messages.note: Persist admitted IDs before advancing scan checkpoints

messages.label: Download files
messages.note: Authenticated message only; limits before downloads

messages.label: Verify + save files
messages.note: Size / SHA-256 match complete MIME; ordinary project retention

messages.label: Request + file refs
messages.note: Sender history only; no operator memories or shared learning writes

messages.label: Threaded reply
messages.note: Fixed From recipient; original thread / Message-ID; no CC, BCC or reply-all

messages.label: Poll summary
messages.note: Per-message read warnings do not fail the workflow; scan / send failures do

messages.label: Reply in thread
messages.note: Gmail acceptance is separate from the sender opening the reply

cards.title: Approval and routing
items: contacts.json supplies opt-in, approved senders and the request tool allowlist.
Workspace flag and Gmail search/read/send dependencies must be available.
Admission requires aligned DKIM + DMARC, a direct plain-text request and a valid envelope.
Sender approval is reloaded before execution and again before delivery.

cards.title: Personal context stays isolated
items: The model receives the latest body request, verified attachment Stash refs and this sender’s last three completed exchanges.
Operator memories, shared conversation context, Intelligence insights and learning writes are disabled.
Provider-hosted tools and explicit workflows are disabled inside the email request.
The allowlist filters discovery and execution without stopping shared Gmail clients. Normal private logs remain.

cards.title: Durable recovery
items: Each poll owns an OS lock; the ledger prevents replay of recorded message IDs.
Failed reads stop after three failures: read_retry → read_failed. These are poll warnings.
Attachment transfers resume saved files across polls; three failed preparations produce a failure reply before business tools run.
Malformed or unauthorized mail is ignored before tools run.
Interrupted execution produces a saved interruption reply; it never automatically reruns.
A saved reply can send despite discovery failure. Unconfirmed delivery → needs_attention; inspect Gmail Sent.
completed means a Gmail receipt was obtained; request_ok separately records whether the requested action succeeded.
